description: Self-Hosted PostgreSQL — Fallback / on-premise or cost-sensitive deployments where a managed offering isn't available or desired — Identical schema and EF Core provider; operational burden (patching, backups, high availability) shifts to the hosting operator, so the backup/restore discipline in 11. Backup Strategy and 12. Restore Strategy must be executed and verified manually rather than relied upon from a managed platform
